rows: I am not in the mood for speeches. Let us go.
Brawling is the only language I speak properly.
Risk? Bring it on, I am ready.
Slow is for people who are scared.
The people want it loud, so loud it is.
I am angry and I am ready.
I have been hungry for this, and I have not stopped.
Look at my stance. It says I want the fight.
You talk technique. Show me what you can take.
Strikes are my favourite part, if I am honest.
A risk is a chance to hit someone properly.
A stall annoys me. Stop wasting time.
The people deserve a proper scrap. Give it to them.
You say you are the best. Stop talking and prove it.
You are proud of your strength. Fine. I will test it.
Your strength is in front of me. Let us see if it stands.
You kept calm. Good, but calm does not win fights.
I could say a lot. I would rather hit.
One fall. Keep me down, you will not manage it.
On the mat I will push hard. Keep up.
Grounded or standing, I am still coming at you.
Stay in front of me. I want the fight.
You have not answered me. Answer with a punch.
Fair point, but I still want the fight.
I accept it. Bell and fight.
I will fight this match and I will not hold back.
My approach is angry and direct. You will see it on the night.
Whatever happens, I will go down swinging.
It is not finished. I want more.
I have one more hit. You will feel it when the bell rings.
